origin.description: The device location the author chose to publish at posting time. It is independent of the area the content concerns and is not evidence of presence.

lat.description: WGS 84 latitude in millionths of a degree.

lon.description: WGS 84 longitude in millionths of a degree.

acc.description: Positioning accuracy as a distance in millimeters. Omit when unknown.

at.description: When the position was measured. UTC with an uppercase Z suffix; preserve the original string. Omit when unknown.

area.description: The geographic area the content concerns, expressed as the union of circles and Geohash cells. A delivery and display hint, not an access boundary.

regions.description: Regions whose union is the area. Circles and Geohash cells may be mixed. Preserve element order.

approximation.description: True when regions are a covering approximation of an original area (for example a polygon or administrative area code) resolved by the publisher; every point of the original area lies within the union. Omit or false when the author specified the regions directly.

region.description: One element of an area. The shape field selects which other fields are present: circle uses lat, lon and r (latitudeMicrodegrees, longitudeMicrodegrees and radiusMillimeters); geohash uses hash.

lat.description: Circle center WGS 84 latitude in millionths of a degree.

lon.description: Circle center WGS 84 longitude in millionths of a degree.

hash.description: Geohash cell code (base32 Geohash alphabet). Cell size follows code length.
